description: Add, update, delete or move a VPS firewall rule (positions from get_vserver_firewall). add/update need type and ruleAction; update replaces the whole rule, so send every field to keep (omitted optional fields are cleared). Requires confirm=true. Requires an active ZapX Pass (see server instructions).

dest.description: add/update: destination address, CIDR or +ipset_name. Empty = any.

macro.description: add/update: Proxmox firewall macro instead of proto/ports, e.g. SSH, HTTP, HTTPS, DNS, Ping.

newPos.description: move: target position. add: optional insert position; default is after the existing customer rules (lowest priority, first match wins), so pass newPos to place a rule above an earlier ACCEPT.

pos.description: update/delete/move: `pos` of the rule as returned by get_vserver_firewall.

proto.description: add/update: protocol, e.g. tcp, udp, icmp, icmpv6.

ruleAction.description: add/update: what the rule does with matching traffic.

serviceId.description: ID of the VPS: the "id" field from list_account_services or list_vservers (e.g. "cmabc123..."). The numericId shown in the panel (e.g. "180") is accepted too. IDs of other service types do not work here.

source.description: add/update: source address, CIDR or +ipset_name (IP set of this VPS). Empty = any.

name: mutate_vserver_firewall_rule
title: Change VPS Firewall Rule
